summary: Leading the development of Pine Hosting's public website and pricing platform (Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind), and the Ansible automation that deploys and maintains the game-server node fleet. Also set up FreeIPA (with SSSD for machine authentication) and Keycloak via OIDC so every internal system shares a single source of truth for accounts, and maintain the company's forks of the open-source Pterodactyl Panel and Wings daemon.

Provisioned and operated client AWS infrastructure with Terraform (VPC, EC2, load balancers, Route 53, ACM, S3, EKS), and built blockchain-based digital identity and document-signing platforms (Solidity/Hardhat smart contracts, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL/MongoDB) for enterprise clients.
